sentences.en: Hey, I'm Benjamin Poulin and I'm Mark Ronson and welcome to The Reframers, a podcast that's all about the love of design and the culture that surrounds it.
sentences.zh: 嘿，我是本杰明·普兰，我是马克·朗森，欢迎收听《重构者》，这是一档专注于设计之爱及其周边文化的播客。

sentences.en: Even back when I was DJing in nightclubs in the era of vinyl,
sentences.zh: 即使是在我还在黑胶唱片时代于夜店担任DJ的时候，

sentences.en: every night you took 300 of your most prized possessions to work with you and you turned a DJ booth into this like living pop-up museum of beautiful 50-year-old artifacts.
sentences.zh: 每天晚上你都要带着300件最珍贵的藏品去工作，把DJ台变成一个充满50年历史精美文物的活体快闪博物馆。

sentences.en: Listen to The Reframers from Audemars Piguet now on your favorite podcast platforMs.
sentences.zh: 现在就在你最喜欢的播客平台上收听爱彼出品的《重构者》吧。

sentences.en: From The New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴尔巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: Behind the decision to separate children from their parents was a flood of migrants from Central America that began under President Obama and hasn't stopped.
sentences.zh: 导致将儿童与其父母分离这一决定的背后，是一股始于奥巴马总统任期内且至今未停的来自中美洲的移民潮。

sentences.en: What they are fleeing.
sentences.zh: 他们正在逃离什么。

sentences.en: Monday, June 25th.
sentences.zh: 6月25日，星期一。

sentences.en: When I first started going to El Salvador, it was largely focused around this immense violence.
sentences.zh: 当我刚开始前往萨尔瓦多时，那里的情况主要集中在极其严重的暴力问题上。

sentences.en: These gangs that had infiltrated practically the entire country and had been doing so for the last decade.
sentences.zh: 这些帮派几乎渗透了整个国家，并且在过去十年里一直如此。

sentences.en: It was such a pervasive phenomenon, there was almost nothing else to write about in a place like El Salvador.
sentences.zh: 这是一种极其普遍的现象，在萨尔瓦多这样的地方，几乎没有其他话题可写。

sentences.en: Azam Ahmed covers Central America for The Times.
sentences.zh: 阿扎姆·艾哈迈德为《纽约时报》报道中美洲新闻。

sentences.en: The latest and most bitter round of fighting in El Salvador's civil war has claimed thousands of lives.
sentences.zh: 萨尔瓦多内战中最新且最惨烈的一轮战斗已经夺去了数千人的生命。

sentences.en: So El Salvador, obviously it had had a pretty violent and extreme civil war.
sentences.zh: 所以萨尔瓦多，显然它经历过一场相当暴力且极端的内战。

sentences.en: And during that period, which bled into the 90s, many of the Salvadorians who were living through this sort of awful guerrilla war were fleeing to the U.S.
sentences.zh: 在那段一直延续到90年代的时期，许多经历过这种可怕游击战的萨尔瓦多人开始逃往美国。

sentences.en: Their prime destination, Los Angeles.
sentences.zh: 他们的首选目的地是洛杉矶。

sentences.en: Los Angeles is the modern Ellis Island for Central America.
sentences.zh: 洛杉矶是中美洲的现代埃利斯岛。

sentences.en: Now, these new arrivals to Los Angeles were suddenly greeted by a different brand of poverty and violence there.
sentences.zh: 现在，这些刚抵达洛杉矶的新移民，突然又面临着另一种贫困和暴力。

sentences.en: It was not the ideological violence of the war they were leaving.
sentences.zh: 那不是他们所逃离的战争中的意识形态暴力。

sentences.en: It was criminal violence.
sentences.zh: 那是犯罪暴力。

sentences.en: It was sort of this self-protective violence.
sentences.zh: 那是一种带有自我保护性质的暴力。

sentences.en: In the barrios of L.A., young refugees encountered criminal gangs and formed gangs of their own.
sentences.zh: 在洛杉矶的街区里，年轻的难民遇到了犯罪团伙，并组建了自己的帮派。

sentences.en: That's where MS-13 and the 18th Street Gang were formed.
sentences.zh: 这就是MS-13和18街帮派形成的地方。

sentences.en: In the U.S.?
sentences.zh: 在美国？

sentences.en: In the U.S.
sentences.zh: 在美国。

sentences.en: They were mostly teenagers from El Salvador who had fled the growing conflict in their country
sentences.zh: 他们大多是来自萨尔瓦多的青少年，为了逃避国内日益严重的冲突，

sentences.en: and banded together here on the streets of Los Angeles, forming the gang mainly to protect themselves from other street gangs.
sentences.zh: 聚集在洛杉矶的街头，组建帮派主要是为了保护自己免受其他街头帮派的侵害。

sentences.en: The original kids that started MS were mostly stoner kids that were into heavy metal music.
sentences.zh: 最初创立MS的那些孩子大多是喜欢重金属音乐的瘾君子。

sentences.en: The MS-13 gang is an American creation.
sentences.zh: MS-13帮派是美国的产物。

sentences.en: It was American-born on this soil right here in Los Angeles.
sentences.zh: 它是在洛杉矶这片土地上土生土长的。

sentences.en: Well, see, many, many of us had experienced violence in our home countries.
sentences.zh: 嗯，你看，我们许多人都在祖国经历过暴力。

sentences.en: You know, on the way to school, they used to see decapitated bodies.
sentences.zh: 你知道，在去学校的路上，他们经常看到被斩首的尸体。

sentences.en: That's why the gangs became an option.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么加入帮派成为了一种选择。

sentences.en: Now, as these gangs sort of start to grow and the criminality and the violence that they exploit grow as well, the United States begins arresting and deporting these guys.
sentences.zh: 现在，随着这些帮派开始壮大，他们所利用的犯罪和暴力活动也在增长，美国开始逮捕并驱逐这些人。

sentences.en: We intend to target them.
sentences.zh: 我们打算针对他们采取行动。

sentences.en: The FBI and the other investigative agencies are going to wage a coordinated war on gangs that involve juveniles in violent crime.
sentences.zh: 联邦调查局和其他调查机构将对涉及青少年暴力犯罪的帮派发动协同打击。

sentences.en: We will do that.
sentences.zh: 我们会做到这一点。

sentences.en: The Attorney General and I are very concerned about the problem of gangs.
sentences.zh: 司法部长和我对帮派问题非常担忧。

sentences.en: And there are too many violent gangs now which go out and try to involve juveniles in serious, serious criminal activity.
sentences.zh: 现在有太多的暴力帮派走上街头，试图将青少年卷入严重的犯罪活动中。

sentences.en: That's why our administration has moved aggressively to secure our borders more by hiring a record number of new border guards,
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么我们政府采取了积极措施，通过雇佣创纪录数量的新边境警卫来加强边境安全，

sentences.en: by deporting twice as many criminal aliens as ever before.
sentences.zh: 通过驱逐比以往任何时候多两倍的犯罪外籍人员。

sentences.en: Now, by now, the war in El Salvador has ended.
sentences.zh: 现在，萨尔瓦多的战争已经结束了。

sentences.en: And there is a treaty between both the guerrillas and the government.
sentences.zh: 游击队和政府之间也达成了条约。

sentences.en: And there is this new kind of coalition government.
sentences.zh: 并且出现了一种新的联合政府。

sentences.en: But it's a broken country.
sentences.zh: 但这是一个破碎的国家。

sentences.en: So you've got what amounts to an institutionalizing, informal gang, forming roots in a country where there are no institutions, where it is sort of a free-for-all.
sentences.zh: 所以你拥有的是一个相当于制度化的、非正式的帮派，在一个没有制度、一切皆可发生的国家扎下了根。

sentences.en: But inevitably, that begins to transform into something much more violent, into something more coherent, into something that looks more like a criminal organization.
sentences.zh: 但不可避免地，它开始演变成更暴力、更连贯、看起来更像犯罪组织的东西。

sentences.en: And it just got worse and worse.
sentences.zh: 而且情况变得越来越糟。

sentences.en: So by the end of the first decade of the 2000s, you've seen these gangs mature and spread and become these cohesive, very difficult-to-root-out institutions.
sentences.zh: 所以到了21世纪的第一个十年末，你已经看到这些帮派成熟、扩张，并成为了这些难以根除的、具有凝聚力的机构。

sentences.en: It's not just kids gang-banging on a corner.
sentences.zh: 这不仅仅是孩子们在街角混帮派。

sentences.en: It is now sophisticated structures of extortion with hierarchical command structures.
sentences.zh: 现在它们是具有层级指挥结构的复杂勒索组织。

sentences.en: And it begins to seep into almost every facet of life in the larger cities and even out in the rural communities of El Salvador.
sentences.zh: 它开始渗透到萨尔瓦多大城市甚至农村社区生活的几乎每一个方面。

sentences.en: Mothers and young children from Central America crowd a bus station in Phoenix, Arizona.
sentences.zh: 来自中美洲的母亲和幼童挤满了亚利桑那州凤凰城的汽车站。

sentences.en: In the past two months, tens of thousands of Central American women and children have been escaping intolerable violence and poverty at home,
sentences.zh: 在过去的两个月里，成千上万的中美洲妇女和儿童一直在逃离国内无法忍受的暴力和贫困，

sentences.en: believing they can get legal status in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 相信他们可以在美国获得合法身份。

sentences.en: And that was accompanied by a massive exodus of people fleeing that violence.
sentences.zh: 随之而来的是大规模逃离暴力的人群。

sentences.en: Tens of thousands of people began to leave in the immediate aftermath.
sentences.zh: 紧随其后，成千上万的人开始离开。

sentences.en: The Pentagon said today it is opening a third emergency shelter for thousands of unaccompanied children who are pouring into the United States from Central America.
sentences.zh: 五角大楼今天表示，正在为数千名从中美洲涌入美国的无人陪伴儿童开设第三个紧急避难所。

sentences.en: Over the last year, the number of children crossing illegally has surged from 24,000 to 47,000.
sentences.zh: 在过去的一年里，非法越境的儿童人数从2.4万激增至4.7万。

sentences.en: About 1,000 unaccompanied children who turned themselves in to the Border Patrol are being held in this warehouse in Nogales, Arizona.
sentences.zh: 大约1000名向边境巡逻队自首的无人陪伴儿童被关押在亚利桑那州诺加莱斯的这个仓库里。

sentences.en: They were transferred from Texas, where government shelters have been overwhelmed.
sentences.zh: 他们是从德克萨斯州转移过来的，那里的政府避难所已经不堪重负。

sentences.en: Small children crossing into the U.S.
sentences.zh: 年幼的孩子越境进入美国，

sentences.en: in many cases alone without their parents and then getting trapped in limbo.
sentences.zh: 在许多情况下是独自一人，没有父母，然后陷入了困境。

sentences.en: These images obtained by ABC News revealing people sleeping on what looks like foil.
sentences.zh: 美国广播公司新闻部获得的这些画面显示，人们睡在看起来像锡箔纸的东西上。

sentences.en: Tonight, just one snapshot of what some are calling now an urgent humanitarian problem.
sentences.zh: 今晚，这只是人们现在所称的紧急人道主义问题的一个缩影。

sentences.en: And it was harrowing to see kids who weren't even old enough to have graduated from high school, some of whom were as young as elementary age, turning up by themselves.
sentences.zh: 看到那些甚至还没到高中毕业年龄的孩子，有些甚至还是小学生，独自出现，真是令人心碎。

sentences.en: And it was for a variety of reasons.
sentences.zh: 原因多种多样。

sentences.en: But among them, you had parents thinking, it's safer for my kid to take this journey on their own than it is for them to stay here.
sentences.zh: 但其中之一是，父母们认为，让孩子独自踏上这段旅程比留在这里更安全。

sentences.en: It's that devastating.
sentences.zh: 就是这么令人绝望。

sentences.en: You know, I think my child is better marching 1,000 miles through Mexico, which is by no means a safe country,
sentences.zh: 你知道，我认为我的孩子独自穿过墨西哥走1000英里——那绝不是一个安全的国家——

sentences.en: to arrive at a border in an uncertain future than he is staying in our neighborhood, in whatever municipality they're living at in En Salvador.
sentences.zh: 去抵达一个充满不确定未来的边境，比待在我们所在的社区，无论他们住在萨尔瓦多的哪个城市，都要好。

sentences.en: It is a huge humanitarian crisis on the border right now.
sentences.zh: 现在边境正面临巨大的人道主义危机。

sentences.en: A gigantic, unprecedented surge of minors, most without parents or guardians, crossing our southern border on their own by the thousands.
sentences.zh: 成千上万的未成年人，大多数没有父母或监护人，独自越过我们的南部边境，这是一股巨大且史无前例的浪潮。

sentences.en: Captured by the border patrol...
sentences.zh: 被边境巡逻队抓获……

sentences.en: It wasn't just El Salvador.
sentences.zh: 这不仅仅是萨尔瓦多的问题。

sentences.en: It was the rest of the so-called Northern Triangle countries, which includes Honduras and Guatemala.
sentences.zh: 这是所谓的北三角国家其余部分的问题，包括洪都拉斯和危地马拉。

sentences.en: So you've got gang phenomenon, criminality, corruption, all of the sort of factors that lead to crisis present in these countries.
sentences.zh: 所以你拥有帮派现象、犯罪、腐败，所有导致危机的因素都存在于这些国家中。

sentences.en: You started to see tens of thousands of kids showing up at the U.S.
sentences.zh: 你开始看到成千上万的孩子出现在美国边境，

sentences.en: border, reaching, it was almost double the previous year, which culminate in this 2014 migration crisis, where suddenly 60,000 kids are showing up at the border,
sentences.zh: 几乎是前一年的两倍，这在2014年移民危机中达到顶峰，当时突然有6万名儿童出现在边境，

sentences.en: and the United States has no idea how to handle it.
sentences.zh: 而美国根本不知道该如何处理。

sentences.en: They show the teens and younger children packed into fence cages and on hard floors.
sentences.zh: 他们展示了挤在围栏笼子里和坚硬地板上的青少年和更小的孩子。

sentences.en: Advocacy groups today formally complaining to the Department of Homeland Security that 80% of the children had inadequate food and water supplies.
sentences.zh: 倡导组织今天正式向国土安全部投诉，称80%的儿童食物和水供应不足。

sentences.en: And it was a public reckoning.
sentences.zh: 这是一次公开的清算。

sentences.en: It was the first time, and it was the Obama administration at the time, where they were like, wow, things are so bad, children are willing to take this trip alone,
sentences.zh: 这是第一次，当时还是奥巴马政府，他们意识到，情况太糟糕了，孩子们宁愿独自踏上这段旅程，

sentences.en: and not just a few of them, tens of thousands of them.
sentences.zh: 而且不仅仅是几个，而是成千上万。

sentences.en: Our message absolutely is don't send your children unaccompanied
sentences.zh: 我们的信息绝对是：不要让你的孩子无人陪伴地

sentences.en: on trains or through a bunch of smugglers.
sentences.zh: 乘坐火车或通过一群走私者（前来）。

sentences.en: We don't even know how many of these kids don't make it and may have been waylaid into sex trafficking or killed because they fell off a train.
sentences.zh: 我们甚至不知道有多少孩子没能到达目的地，可能在途中被拐卖或因从火车上掉下来而丧生。

sentences.en: We have no way of tracking that.
sentences.zh: 我们无法追踪这些情况。

sentences.en: So that is our direct message to the families in Central America.
sentences.zh: 所以这是我们给中美洲家庭的直接信息。

sentences.en: Do not send your children to the borders.
sentences.zh: 不要把你的孩子送到边境来。

sentences.en: So there was this crisis in the Obama administration.
sentences.zh: 所以奥巴马政府当时面临着这场危机。

sentences.en: What are we going to do?
sentences.zh: 我们该怎么办？

sentences.en: We have children showing up at our borders.
sentences.zh: 我们的边境出现了儿童。

sentences.en: They have to do something.
sentences.zh: 他们必须采取行动。

sentences.en: It's a white-hot focus of the news, this influx of children on the border.
sentences.zh: 这是新闻关注的焦点，边境上出现的这股儿童涌入潮。

sentences.en: And so they reached out to Mexico.
sentences.zh: 于是他们联系了墨西哥。

sentences.en: Welcome, everybody.
sentences.zh: 欢迎大家。

sentences.en: Police and the arrival.
sentences.zh: 警察和抵达。

sentences.en: It is a pleasure to welcome once again President Peña Nieto, as well as his delegation.
sentences.zh: 很高兴再次欢迎培尼亚·涅托总统及其代表团。

sentences.en: Now, in Mexico, for the longest time, it's just been a transit route.
sentences.zh: 在墨西哥，长期以来，它一直只是一个过境路线。

sentences.en: You know, you jumped on the train.
sentences.zh: 你知道，你跳上火车。

sentences.en: You kind of transited through because the destination was the United States.
sentences.zh: 你只是过境，因为目的地是美国。

sentences.en: And what the U.S.
sentences.zh: 而美国政府所做的，就是要求墨西哥政府：你们能更仔细地监管你们的南部边境吗？

sentences.en: government did was they asked the Mexican government, can you start more carefully policing your southern border?
sentences.zh: 本质上是将移民搜捕网一直延伸到墨西哥和危地马拉的边境。

sentences.en: Essentially extending the migrant dragnet all the way down to the border of Mexico and Guatemala.
sentences.zh: 墨西哥对此作出了什么回应？

sentences.en: And what did Mexico do in response?
sentences.zh: 墨西哥照办了。

sentences.en: Mexico complied.
sentences.zh: 他们启动了一项名为“南部边境计划”的方案，这基本上就是一个南部边境计划。

sentences.en: They launched a plan called Plan Fonterasur, which is basically a southern border plan.
sentences.zh: 他们加强了那里的安保。

sentences.en: And they beefed up their security there.
sentences.zh: 他们加强了海关人员、道路和各条高速公路的巡逻。

sentences.en: They beefed up their customs agents, vigilance of the roads and various highways.
sentences.zh: 他们开始监控火车，这列被称为“野兽”的著名火车，多年来移民们一直乘坐它从墨西哥和中美洲前往美国。

sentences.en: And they started monitoring the train, this famous train known as the Beast, that migrants had been taking from both Mexico and Central America for years and years and years.
sentences.zh: 那条路线至少暂时对人们关闭了。

sentences.en: That became a route that at least temporarily was shut off to people.
sentences.zh: 在美国被拘留的移民人数下降了。

sentences.en: The number of migrants that were detained in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 而且相当显著，问题在于移民的实际人数并没有减少。

sentences.en: dropped.
sentences.zh: 他们只是没有在美国被拘留，而是在墨西哥南部边境被拘留了。

sentences.en: And pretty significantly, the problem was the actual number of migrants didn't drop.
sentences.zh: 所以实际上，他们并没有解决问题。

sentences.en: They just, instead of being detained in the United States, they were detained in the southern border of Mexico.
sentences.zh: 他们只是转移了问题。

sentences.en: So in reality, they didn't solve the problem.
sentences.zh: 移民人数继续不断上升。

sentences.en: They just moved it.
sentences.zh: 奥巴马政策讽刺的地方在于，它实际上让那段旅程变得更加危险。

sentences.en: And the number of migrants continued going up and up.
sentences.zh: 因为现在，这些移民不再能自由穿过墨西哥，而是被迫采取迂回路线，

sentences.en: And the ironic portion of Obama's policy was that it actually made that trip more dangerous.
sentences.zh: 依赖所谓的“蛇头”或走私者带他们穿越这片地形，最终承担了更多个人风险。

sentences.en: Because now, rather than having sort of free passage through Mexico, these migrants were forced into taking circuitous routes,
sentences.zh: 因此，在试图抑制出现在边境的儿童数量时，奥巴马政府的政策实际上让许多人开始穿越墨西哥的旅程变得更加危险。

sentences.en: relying on what they call coyotes or smugglers to get them through this terrain, and ultimately taking a lot more personal risk.
sentences.zh: 但重点不是要阻止他们尝试吗？

sentences.en: So in trying to inhibit the number of children showing up at the border, the Obama administration's policy actually made it far more dangerous for many of them
sentences.zh: 我认为我们学到的一点是，这些政策在长期内并不能真正阻止人们。

sentences.en: to even begin their journey through Mexico.
sentences.zh: 当你想要离开时，当你做出那个决定时，当你决定在这里生活已经没有意义时，

sentences.en: But wasn't the point to discourage them from trying it at all?
sentences.zh: 这些障碍与你已经做出的决定、不得不得出“我不能再待在家里”的结论相比，显得微不足道。

sentences.en: I think one thing we've learned is that these policies don't really discourage people in the long term.
sentences.zh: 嘿，我是本杰明·普兰。

sentences.en: When you want to leave, when you've made that decision, when you have decided that my life is not worth living here,
sentences.zh: 我是马克·朗森。

sentences.en: these impediments, they're small in comparison to having had made that decision, having to come to the conclusion I can't be at home anymore.

sentences.zh: 充满50年历史精美文物的活体快闪博物馆。

sentences.zh: 现在就在你最喜欢的播客平台上收听爱彼出品的《重构者》吧。

sentences.en: Even back when I was DJing in nightclubs in the era of vinyl, every night you took 300 of your most prized possessions to work with you, and you turned a DJ booth into this, like,
sentences.zh: 嗨，我是安德鲁·罗斯-索金。

sentences.zh: 所以2016年，我想亲眼看看那是什么样子。

sentences.en: If you're not already a subscriber, you can download the New York Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 我想看看这段旅程发生了怎样的变化。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 长期以来，这列火车在中美洲到美国的过境路线上占据了很大比重。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 但现在人们开始步行了。

sentences.en: So in 2016, I wanted to actually see what it looked like.
sentences.zh: 嘿，我是本杰明·普兰，我是马克·朗森，欢迎收听《重构者》，这是一档专注于设计之爱及其周边文化的播客。

sentences.en: I wanted to see the ways in which this journey had changed.
sentences.zh: 即使是在我还在黑胶唱片时代于夜店担任DJ的时候，

sentences.en: For so long, this train kind of loomed large on the transit from Central America to the United States.
sentences.zh: 每天晚上你都要带着300件最珍贵的藏品去工作，把DJ台变成一个充满50年历史精美文物的活体快闪博物馆。

sentences.en: But now people were going on foot.
sentences.zh: 现在就在你最喜欢的播客平台上收听爱彼出品的《重构者》吧。

sentences.en: So I went down to the state of Chiapas, which is on the border with Guatemala, and convinced a group of migrants to let me go with them.
sentences.zh: 我去了恰帕斯州，那里与危地马拉接壤，并说服了一群移民让我和他们同行。

sentences.en: So for several days, we sort of made this trek through southern Mexico on the way up to the United States.
sentences.zh: 于是，我们花了几天时间，一路跋涉穿过墨西哥南部，向美国进发。

sentences.en: And almost from the very moment it started, it was so clearly different.
sentences.zh: 几乎从旅程开始的那一刻起，情况就明显不同了。

sentences.en: We were walking through the streets of this small town, and someone came up to us and warned us, hey, you know, the cops, and they call them Migra, the migration authorities,
sentences.zh: 我们走在这个小镇的街道上，有人走过来警告我们，嘿，你们知道吗，警察——他们称之为“移民局”，即移民管理部门——

sentences.en: they come through here a lot.
sentences.zh: 经常来这里巡逻。

sentences.en: And so the migrants thank the guy.
sentences.zh: 移民们向那个人道了谢。

sentences.en: And 30 seconds later, we hear a siren.
sentences.zh: 30秒后，我们听到了警笛声。

sentences.en: And the cops start chasing us.
sentences.zh: 警察开始追赶我们。

sentences.en: And so these guys just take off sprinting.
sentences.zh: 这些人立刻撒腿就跑。

sentences.en: So I sprint with them.
sentences.zh: 我也跟着他们一起狂奔。

sentences.en: And we run to the edge of town, and we start hiding sort of behind this slight rise on the edge of town.
sentences.zh: 我们跑到镇子边缘，躲在镇边的一个小土坡后面。

sentences.en: Within 20 minutes, a guy approaches us.
sentences.zh: 不到20分钟，一个人向我们走来。

sentences.en: Turns out he happens to be a smuggler.
sentences.zh: 原来他正好是个蛇头。

sentences.en: And he tells us, hey, guys, you know, luck would have it.
sentences.zh: 他告诉我们，嘿，伙计们，你们运气不错。

sentences.en: I know how to get you out of this town and through the next several towns, and I'll do it all for X price.
sentences.zh: 我知道怎么带你们离开这个镇子，穿过接下来的几个城镇，只要付我多少钱就行。

sentences.en: And so the migrants, they were pretty sophisticated about what was happening.
sentences.zh: 移民们对正在发生的事情相当精明。

sentences.en: They began to quiz the coyote, asking him, okay, where are you going to take us?
sentences.zh: 他们开始盘问那个蛇头，问他：好吧，你要带我们去哪儿？

sentences.en: How's it going to work?
sentences.zh: 具体怎么操作？

sentences.en: I remember one of them pulled out this, it was a packaging for medicine, and he opened it up.
sentences.zh: 我记得其中一个人掏出一个东西，那是药品的包装盒，他把它打开了。

sentences.en: It was cardboard, and on it, he had written by hand every city that he was meant to go through.
sentences.zh: 那是硬纸板，上面手写着他计划经过的每一个城市。

sentences.en: So he basically knew the route, and he began to quiz the smuggler, like, well, what's next?
sentences.zh: 他基本上了解路线，于是开始盘问蛇头，比如：那接下来去哪儿？

sentences.en: And the smuggler would name a city.
sentences.zh: 蛇头会说出一个城市名。

sentences.en: He's like, okay, and what's after that?
sentences.zh: 他又问：好的，那之后呢？

sentences.en: And you'd name a city.
sentences.zh: 蛇头又报出一个城市名。

sentences.en: And the guy was checking off to ensure that this guy actually did know where he was.
sentences.zh: 那个人在核对，以确保这个蛇头确实知道自己在哪里。

sentences.en: And this guy was promising the sun and the moon.
sentences.zh: 而这个蛇头把一切吹得天花乱坠。

sentences.en: Oh, I've got cars set up.
sentences.zh: 哦，我已经安排好车了。

sentences.en: I have people here.
sentences.zh: 我有人在那边。

sentences.en: Yeah, they've got all these stops, but I know where all the stops are, so we'll drive up to it.
sentences.zh: 是啊，他们设了很多关卡，但我知道所有关卡的位置，所以我们会开车过去。

sentences.en: You guys will get out.
sentences.zh: 你们下车。

sentences.en: I'll lead you on a security route back onto the highway, and then we'll go again.
sentences.zh: 我会带你们走一条安全路线回到公路上，然后我们继续出发。

sentences.en: The idea being you won't have to walk the entire time.
sentences.zh: 意思是你们不必全程步行。

sentences.en: This is like an interaction between a buyer and a seller.
sentences.zh: 这就像买家和卖家之间的互动。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: They really didn't have a choice.
sentences.zh: 他们其实别无选择。

sentences.en: They didn't know how to get out of this town.
sentences.zh: 他们不知道怎么离开这个镇子。

sentences.en: You know, the cops were swarming.
sentences.zh: 你知道，警察到处都是。

sentences.en: And after you've left your town, you've made that decision to make this trip, the last thing in the world you want to do is get sent back.
sentences.zh: 既然已经离开了家乡，下定决心踏上这段旅程，你最不想发生的事就是被遣返回去。

sentences.en: The only option was to go with the smuggler, and so they did.
sentences.zh: 唯一的选择就是跟着蛇头，于是他们照做了。

sentences.en: And then what happened when they joined forces with the smuggler?
sentences.zh: 那么，当他们与蛇头联手后发生了什么？

sentences.en: We started walking, and it turned out almost everything the smuggler had promised was hollow.
sentences.zh: 我们开始步行，结果发现蛇头承诺的一切几乎都是空话。

sentences.en: There were no cars waiting for us.
sentences.zh: 根本没有车在等我们。

sentences.en: There were no buses.
sentences.zh: 也没有巴士。

sentences.en: We took this incredibly circuitous route off of the highway, along the railroad, often other sort of unmarked paths, for 30 kilometers each of the days we were going.
sentences.zh: 我们走了极其迂回的路线，避开公路，沿着铁轨，经常走一些没有标记的小路，每天都要走30公里。

sentences.en: And the guys were soldiers.
sentences.zh: 那些人简直是铁打的。

sentences.en: They didn't stop for breaks.
sentences.zh: 他们从不休息。

sentences.en: They moved briskly.
sentences.zh: 他们走得很快。

sentences.en: They were adamant about keeping the pace up.
sentences.zh: 他们坚持要保持速度。

sentences.en: They didn't want to slow down.
sentences.zh: 他们不想慢下来。

sentences.en: And it was, you know, pretty brutal conditions.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，环境相当残酷。

sentences.en: You're talking about 90-plus degree heat, mosquitoes everywhere, very little shade, so you're out in the sun.
sentences.zh: 气温高达30多摄氏度，到处是蚊子，几乎没有遮荫的地方，所以你得在烈日下暴晒。

sentences.en: At the end of our first night, we wound up in this small town.
sentences.zh: 第一天晚上结束时，我们到了一个小镇。

sentences.en: It was about 10 p.m., 11 p.m.
sentences.zh: 大约是晚上10点或11点。

sentences.en: You know, we'd been walking since maybe 5.30 that morning.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我们从那天早上5点半就开始走了。

sentences.en: And as we walk into town, we pass a group of men drinking in sort of a central plaza.
sentences.zh: 当我们走进镇子时，经过一群正在中心广场喝酒的男人。

sentences.en: And they began to yell threats.
sentences.zh: 他们开始大声威胁。

sentences.en: They see these migrants coming through.
sentences.zh: 他们看到这些移民经过。

sentences.en: And they began to call them names.
sentences.zh: 他们开始辱骂他们。

sentences.en: They began to threaten violence.
sentences.zh: 他们开始威胁要施加暴力。

sentences.en: The migrants started sprinting, running away from them.
sentences.zh: 移民们开始狂奔，逃离他们。

sentences.en: We raced to the safe house where the smuggler had sort of set up a place for everybody to spend the night.
sentences.zh: 我们跑向那个安全屋，那是蛇头为所有人安排的过夜地点。

sentences.en: And some ladies across the street called us over.
sentences.zh: 街对面的几位女士把我们叫了过去。

sentences.en: And they told us that we shouldn't spend the night in that house, that people, in particular migrants, had been killed there before.
sentences.zh: 她们告诉我们不应该在那间屋子里过夜，以前有人，特别是移民，在那里被杀害过。

sentences.en: This is the tragedy of this trip.
sentences.zh: 这就是这段旅程的悲剧所在。

sentences.en: You have to trust all these people along the way that you don't know whether you can truSt.
sentences.zh: 你必须信任沿途遇到的所有人，尽管你根本不知道能不能信任他们。

sentences.en: This smuggler, sure, he was going to get paid.
sentences.zh: 这个蛇头，当然，他会拿到报酬。

sentences.en: But who knows?
sentences.zh: 但谁知道呢？

sentences.en: Maybe it would have been worth more to kidnap everybody and sell them to a cartel or some other kind of racket.
sentences.zh: 也许把所有人绑架并卖给贩毒集团或其他犯罪团伙会更值钱。

sentences.en: And this is just in one day.
sentences.zh: 而这仅仅是一天之内发生的事。

sentences.en: How do you understand that determination to march through the heat, the mosquitoes, with so little food and so little water and atrocious conditions?
sentences.zh: 你如何理解那种在高温和蚊虫叮咬下，在食物和水极度匮乏、条件恶劣的情况下依然坚持行进的决心？

sentences.en: How do you understand that?
sentences.zh: 你如何理解那种决心？

sentences.en: I think for a lot of these migrants, it's about survival.
sentences.zh: 我认为对许多移民来说，这关乎生存。

sentences.en: There's a lot of focus on, do these people deserve to get asylum?
sentences.zh: 人们非常关注：这些人是否有资格获得庇护？

sentences.en: Are they truly threatened?
sentences.zh: 他们是否真的受到了威胁？

sentences.en: But ultimately, at the end of the day, I don't think there's a terribly massive amount of difference between my kid might get killed to my child has no future here.
sentences.zh: 但归根结底，我认为“我的孩子可能会被杀”和“我的孩子在这里没有未来”之间并没有太大的区别。

sentences.en: I think this obsession with how real is the threat, how imminent is of the threat, it's missing the point.
sentences.zh: 我认为这种对威胁有多真实、有多迫在眉睫的执念，完全抓错了重点。

sentences.en: Nobody wants to leave home.
sentences.zh: 没有人想离开家园。

sentences.en: Nobody wants to go to a foreign country where they know no one and have no network and restart without any real sense of promise there.
sentences.zh: 没有人想去一个陌生的国家，那里没有认识的人，没有社会关系，还要在没有任何希望的情况下重新开始。

sentences.en: People make these choices because they don't feel like they have an alternative.
sentences.zh: 人们做出这些选择是因为他们觉得别无选择。

sentences.en: Various protests were held Saturday to oppose the government's handling of the migrant crisis, especially the separation of child migrants from their families.
sentences.zh: 周六举行了多场抗议活动，反对政府处理移民危机的方式，特别是将移民儿童与家人分离的做法。

sentences.en: I don't think people can even begin to imagine what it's like to put yourself in the shoes of a four-year-old child
sentences.zh: 我认为人们甚至无法想象，设身处地去感受一个四岁孩子是什么感觉——

sentences.en: in a foreign land, speaking a foreign language, just in a cage like an animal.
sentences.zh: 身处异国他乡，说着外语，就像动物一样被关在笼子里。

sentences.en: These are human beings and they deserve to be treated as such.
sentences.zh: 他们是人类，理应得到应有的对待。

sentences.en: So when President Trump takes a step, like beginning to separate children from their parents who are arriving from countries like El Salvador, what does that do to the flow?
sentences.zh: 那么，当特朗普总统采取行动，比如开始将从萨尔瓦多等国抵达的儿童与父母分离时，这对移民潮有什么影响？

sentences.en: Because the message is clearly designed to be, look at the lengths we are willing to go to discourage you.
sentences.zh: 因为这个信息显然旨在传达：看看我们愿意为了劝阻你们而采取什么极端手段。

sentences.en: So does it discourage?
sentences.zh: 那么，这起到劝阻作用了吗？

sentences.en: I mean, I think to be completely fair, we have yet to see.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，公平地说，我们还有待观察。

sentences.en: We don't know what's going to happen in the next few months.
sentences.zh: 我们不知道未来几个月会发生什么。

sentences.en: But if history is a guide, the various measures taken, the various draconian steps to inhibit this migration, this mass migration, none of them really worked.
sentences.zh: 但如果以史为鉴，过去采取的各种措施，各种旨在抑制这种大规模移民的严苛手段，没有一个是真正奏效的。

sentences.en: The thing behind all of this is that desperation hasn't really changed.
sentences.zh: 这一切背后的真相是，绝望感并没有真正改变。

sentences.en: 2014, we saw this flood of people.
sentences.zh: 2014年，我们看到了这股人潮。

sentences.en: 2015, a flood of people.
sentences.zh: 2015年，又是一股人潮。

sentences.en: 2016, 2017, up to this year.
The numbers dipped slightly after Trump was elected.
sentences.zh: 特朗普当选后，人数略有下降。

sentences.en: And then they went right back to where they were, which tells you one thing.
sentences.zh: 然后又回到了原来的水平，这说明了一件事。

sentences.en: This isn't changing.
sentences.zh: 情况并没有改变。

sentences.en: The only thing that's changed about this is the administration and their policy towards it.
sentences.zh: 唯一改变的是政府及其相关政策。

sentences.en: We have very bad laws for our border.
sentences.zh: 我们的边境法律非常糟糕。

sentences.en: And we are going to be doing some things.
sentences.zh: 我们将采取一些行动。

sentences.en: I've been speaking with General Mattis.
sentences.zh: 我一直在与马蒂斯将军沟通。

sentences.en: We're going to be doing things military-related.
sentences.zh: 我们将采取军事相关的行动。

sentences.en: Until we can have a wall in proper security, we're going to be guarding our border with the military.
sentences.zh: 在建立围墙和实现适当的安全保障之前，我们将用军队守卫边境。

sentences.en: That's a big step.
sentences.zh: 这是一个重大的举措。

sentences.en: So I think it's the draconian punitive measures that have changed.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为，改变的是那些严苛的惩罚性措施。

sentences.en: And with what's happening now at the border, is the desperation that you're describing,
sentences.zh: 那么，针对现在边境发生的情况，你所描述的那种绝望感，

sentences.en: is that why, when presumably these migrants know that they might be separated from their children,
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么，尽管这些移民可能知道他们可能会与孩子分离，

sentences.en: is that why they're still willing to take this risk because of these conditions back at home, because of the pervasiveness of this sense that there's just nothing for them?
sentences.zh: 他们仍然愿意冒这个险吗？是因为家乡的这些状况，因为那种“那里什么都没有”的普遍感吗？

sentences.en: I think from the outside, it might seem illogical.
sentences.zh: 我认为从局外人的角度看，这可能显得不合逻辑。

sentences.en: Why would you go into a country where they could separate you from your children?
sentences.zh: 为什么要去一个可能会让你与孩子分离的国家？

sentences.en: But A, what you mentioned, that desperation is profound.
sentences.zh: 但首先，正如你提到的，那种绝望感是深刻的。

sentences.en: It drives you out.
sentences.zh: 它驱使你离开。

sentences.en: And it, to many, I think, seems like less of a threat than what's back home.
sentences.zh: 而且对许多人来说，我觉得这看起来比留在家里威胁更小。

sentences.en: And that's because they know what's back home.
sentences.zh: 那是因为他们知道家里是什么样。

sentences.en: They've lived what's back home.
sentences.zh: 他们亲身经历过家里的生活。

sentences.en: They've seen it.
sentences.zh: 他们亲眼目睹过。

sentences.en: They've made that calculus in their head.
sentences.zh: 他们在心里权衡过。

sentences.en: Until you can match the desperation that is fueling this,
sentences.zh: 除非你能匹配这种推动移民的绝望感，

sentences.en: until you can completely erase any glimmer of hope that would make a potential life in America better than what amounts to a horrible life in El Salvador,
sentences.zh: 除非你能彻底抹去任何一丝希望——那种让在美国的潜在生活比在萨尔瓦多的糟糕生活更好的希望，

sentences.en: you're not going to change that dynamic.
sentences.zh: 否则你无法改变这种动态。

sentences.en: It's not advocating for more draconian policies.
sentences.zh: 这并不是在提倡更严苛的政策。

sentences.en: It's simply the fact that, like, there's still some semblance of hope because you know what you're leaving.
sentences.zh: 这只是一个事实，因为你知道你要离开的是什么。

sentences.en: You know how bad it is.
sentences.zh: 你知道那里有多糟糕。

sentences.en: You've measured the contours of your desperation.
sentences.zh: 你已经衡量过你绝望的程度。

sentences.en: So I don't think you change people's minds unless you make it worse than what it is in El Salvador.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为，除非你让美国的处境比萨尔瓦多更糟，否则你无法改变人们的想法。

sentences.en: And even then, I'm not sure it's going to change their minds.
sentences.zh: 即便如此，我也不确定这是否能改变他们的想法。

sentences.en: From everything you describe, the conditions in places like El Salvador are not improving.
sentences.zh: 根据你的描述，萨尔瓦多等地的状况并没有改善。

sentences.en: And it's reached a point where almost everyone in a country like that can argue that they are living in fear
sentences.zh: 而且已经到了这样一个地步：像这样的国家里的几乎每个人都可以说他们生活在恐惧中，

sentences.en: and need asylum, which raises an incredibly complicated question for the United States.
sentences.zh: 并需要寻求庇护，这给美国提出了一个极其复杂的问题。

sentences.en: Because if almost everyone in a country is living in fear and could make an argument that they need to come to the United States, what is the U.S.
sentences.zh: 因为如果一个国家里几乎每个人都生活在恐惧中，并且都能提出他们需要来到美国的理由，那么美国

sentences.en: to do?
sentences.zh: 该怎么办？

sentences.en: It couldn't possibly absorb an entire nation.
sentences.zh: 它不可能吸收整个国家的人口。

sentences.en: Yeah, I mean, I think that's a defining question of our time.
sentences.zh: 是的，我的意思是，我认为这是我们这个时代的一个决定性问题。

sentences.en: I think not just in the United States, but in Europe as well.
sentences.zh: 我认为不仅是在美国，在欧洲也是如此。

sentences.en: Other countries where you see populations fleeing desperation, trying to relocate, and governments trying to figure out, well, how do we manage this?
sentences.zh: 在其他国家，你也能看到人们为了逃离绝望而试图迁徙，而政府则在试图弄清楚：我们该如何管理？

sentences.en: What do we do?
sentences.zh: 我们该怎么办？

sentences.en: When do we stop saying yes?
sentences.zh: 我们什么时候停止说“是”？

sentences.en: And at what point do we start saying no?
sentences.zh: 我们又在什么时候开始说“不”？

sentences.en: We can come up with policies to criminalize migrants.
sentences.zh: 我们可以出台政策将移民定罪。

sentences.en: We can come up with ways to convince the Mexicans to do our job for us.
sentences.zh: 我们可以想办法说服墨西哥人为我们做这份工作。

sentences.en: But until those root causes are addressed, the problems of El Salvador are also the problems of the United States.
sentences.zh: 但除非解决这些根本原因，否则萨尔瓦多的问题也就是美国的问题。

sentences.en: Not in the same respect.
sentences.zh: 虽然程度不同。

sentences.en: Not in the body count.
sentences.zh: 伤亡人数不同。

sentences.en: Not in the violence.
sentences.zh: 暴力程度不同。

sentences.en: But in the implications of that body count and that violence.
sentences.zh: 但这些伤亡和暴力所带来的影响是相同的。

sentences.en: In the way that it shows up at our borders in the form of a 14-year-old kid who's just trekked more than 1,000 miles to look for refuge.
sentences.zh: 它以一个14岁孩子的形式出现在我们的边境，他刚刚跋涉了1000多英里来寻求庇护。

sentences.en: It's a challenge that isn't about to go away anytime soon.
sentences.zh: 这是一个短期内不会消失的挑战。

sentences.en: Azam, those men that you traveled with through Mexico, from Central America, trying to reach the U.S.
sentences.zh: 阿扎姆，那些和你一起穿越墨西哥，来自中美洲，试图到达美国边境的人，

sentences.en: border, do you know if they ever made it?
sentences.zh: 你知道他们最终成功了吗？

sentences.en: Only two of them made it.
sentences.zh: 只有两个人成功了。

sentences.en: The other eight, for varying reasons.
sentences.zh: 另外八个人，因为各种原因（没能成功）。

sentences.en: Among them, they were robbed.
sentences.zh: 他们之中有人遭到了抢劫。

sentences.en: Some of them stayed in Mexico.
sentences.zh: 他们有些人留在了墨西哥。

sentences.en: One of them actually went back to Honduras and subsequently lost his life there.
sentences.zh: 其中一人甚至回到了洪都拉斯，结果在那里丢了性命。

sentences.en: The migrant who sort of led the group actually wound up crossing into the United States on Christmas Eve.
sentences.zh: 那个带头的移民最终在平安夜跨过了边境进入美国。

sentences.en: And I think that is ultimately the allure of this journey.
sentences.zh: 我认为这正是这段旅程的诱人之处。

sentences.en: That you can go there and find a job as a dishwasher.
sentences.zh: 你可以去那里找一份洗碗工的工作。

sentences.en: That allure, you just need it to be better than what you're leaving.
sentences.zh: 这种诱惑，只需要比你离开的地方好一点就足够了。

sentences.en: And for those two guys, it certainly has been.
sentences.zh: 对于那两个人来说，情况确实如此。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要了解的其他新闻。

sentences.en: On Saturday night, three days after President Trump signed the executive order ending the separation of children and their parents,
sentences.zh: 周六晚上，在特朗普总统签署结束儿童与其父母分离的行政命令三天后，

sentences.en: his administration announced it had reunited 522 families.
sentences.zh: 他的政府宣布已经让522个家庭实现了团聚。

sentences.en: But about 2,000 separated children remain in federal detention facilities.
sentences.zh: 但仍有约2000名被分离的儿童留在联邦拘留设施中。

sentences.en: On Sunday, Trump once again doubled down on hard-line talk about the situation at the border, calling for migrants arriving there illegally,
sentences.zh: 周日，特朗普再次重申了他在边境问题上的强硬立场，要求非法抵达那里的移民，

sentences.en: to be deprived of their due process rights.
sentences.zh: 被剥夺正当法律程序权利。

sentences.en: We cannot allow all these people to invade our country, the president tweeted.
sentences.zh: 我们不能允许所有这些人入侵我们的国家，总统在推特上写道。

sentences.en: When somebody comes in, we must immediately, with no judges or court cases, bring them back where they came from.
sentences.zh: 当有人进来时，我们必须立即把他们送回他们来的地方，无需法官或法庭审理。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 以上就是本期《每日新闻》的全部内容。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Barbar.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: Hey, I'm Benjamin Poulin.
sentences.zh: 嘿，我是本杰明·普兰。

sentences.en: And I'm Mark Ronson.
sentences.zh: 我是马克·朗森。

sentences.en: And welcome to The Reframers, a podcast that's all about the love of design and the culture that surrounds it.
sentences.zh: 欢迎收听《重构者》，这是一档专注于设计之爱及其周边文化的播客。

sentences.en: Even back when I was DJing in nightclubs, in the era of vinyl, every night you took 300 of your most prized possessions to work with you, and you turned a DJ booth into this, like,
sentences.zh: 即使是在我还在夜店当DJ的黑胶唱片时代，每天晚上你都要带着300件最珍贵的藏品去工作，你会把DJ台变成一个，就像是，

sentences.en: living pop-up museum of beautiful 50-year-old artifacts
sentences.zh: 充满活力的、展示精美50年历史文物的快闪博物馆。

sentences.en: Listen to The Reframers from Audemars Piguet now on your favorite podcast platforMs.
sentences.zh: 现在就在你最喜欢的播客平台上收听爱彼出品的《重构者》。
